title: A room object with a private memory reference
description: Imagine a cross-journey brief where a room's focal object refers quietly to a personal memory.

sections.heading: The imagined brief
paragraphs: Imagine a cross-journey brief where a room's focal object refers quietly to a personal memory. The concept avoids placing the full private story into the public design description.

sections.heading: A proposed design response
paragraphs: Start with one abstract visual relationship, such as a curve or colour direction, and keep the original meaning in a private note. No actual person's memory is represented.
